flower.name: flower
flower.desc: A bright wildflower. Bees love them, and crushed petals could color things.

reed.name: reed
reed.desc: A long hollow stem from the water's edge; it bends without breaking. Bundled, it makes thatch.

mushroom.name: mushroom
mushroom.desc: A pale, earthy mushroom from the forest floor. Edible raw, better cooked.

shell.name: shell
shell.desc: A smooth, pearly shell from the lake beach.

thatch.name: thatch
thatch.desc: Reeds bound in a thick bundle, for a roof that keeps the rain out.

flower_crown.name: flower crown
flower_crown.desc: Flowers woven into a ring to wear on your head. It makes everyone smile.

shell_necklace.name: shell necklace
shell_necklace.desc: Shells strung on a cord. A fine gift for a friend.
